exemptions.m2_pnames_sshd-session: Process NAME from the train-fitted M2 vocabulary ('sshd-session' is the OpenSSH per-connection helper binary). It is a semantic process category, not a per-recording session identifier; the feature is a COUNT of edges touching processes with that name. Matched only because the identifier regex contains r'\bsession\b'. Reviewed and exempted 2026-08-20.
